title: Recent destinations, discovery filters and session continuity

scope.subject: Add browser-session recent destination continuity, Personal/Important/Nearby/Recent Navigator filters and recent ranking priors over canonical destination IDs without creating a second router, database or navigation state machine

research_summary: Agent 07 explicitly calls for recent destinations, current-path context and browser-native/session mechanisms where sufficient. Personal Universe already owns canonical destination IDs, one URL/history substrate, React local state and the Navigator result graph. Reuse those pieces: record only a bounded ordered list of canonical IDs in sessionStorage, derive filter views in the existing Navigator, and feed the same recent IDs as a small ranking prior into the existing bounded search scorer. Do not persist camera/phase/runtime state and do not add a user-account backend, client router, IndexedDB content store or global state library.

sources.finding: sessionStorage is tab-scoped and survives reloads while clearing with the browsing session, matching non-invasive recent-navigation continuity without account or server persistence.
The existing browser-native history/URL layer remains the shareable navigation authority; recent history should store only canonical IDs and never replace URL/deep-link semantics.
Existing React derived state is sufficient for bounded filter views and current-context/recent presentation without another state runtime.
Existing Playwright acceptance can verify reload continuity, filter behavior, recent ordering and canonical-ID navigation through the real Navigator.

search_ladder.conclusion: Keep the existing Personal Universe/YEIS destination and navigation product; recent continuity is presentation metadata over canonical destinations.
Reuse browser-native session and existing URL/history primitives instead of adding a client router, account backend or persistence framework.
Reuse the existing hosted browser acceptance subsystem for continuity, reload and filter product contracts.
Use existing React state/effects/memoization for a bounded filter toolbar and recent-ID state; no third-party state package is needed.

candidates.name: sessionStorage canonical-ID recents on the existing URL/history substrate
candidates.source: Web Platform sessionStorage plus current Personal Universe history model
candidates.reason: Stores only a tiny bounded list of canonical IDs, survives reload in the same tab, clears with the session and cannot become a competing navigation identity or content database.

candidates.name: React-derived Personal/Important/Nearby/Recent filter views
candidates.reason: Filters the already-loaded canonical graph and reuses current system/metadata without rebuilding an index or adding global state.

candidates.name: Existing hosted Playwright continuity acceptance
candidates.reason: Exercises session reload, filter UI, canonical IDs, active state and navigation through the same product path users use.

candidates.name: IndexedDB/account-backed recent destination database
candidates.reason: Disproportionate for a bounded recent list and risks becoming the parallel content/history database Agent 07 forbids.

candidates.name: New global state machine/store for Navigator continuity
candidates.reason: Duplicates the existing React/navigation authorities and adds lifecycle complexity for small derived session state.

coverage_matrix.capability: Recently visited canonical destinations survive reload in the same tab without persisting camera/runtime state
coverage_matrix.decision: Store only up to eight canonical destination IDs in sessionStorage; hydrate safely and discard malformed values.

coverage_matrix.capability: Navigator can narrow Places to personal, important, current-system and recent destinations without duplicating Search
coverage_matrix.decision: Add a compact derived filter toolbar only for empty-query Places; Search continues using the shared ranking/query layer.

coverage_matrix.capability: Recent visits influence search ordering but never identity or exact-match precedence
coverage_matrix.decision: Pass recent canonical IDs into the existing scorer as a small bounded prior below textual exact/title/alias relevance.

coverage_matrix.capability: Responsive bilingual UI and reload continuity remain verifiable in real browser acceptance
coverage_matrix.decision: Extend existing Playwright and locale primitives rather than creating a separate history/filter test or translation system.

decision.rationale: Use only browser-session canonical-ID storage, existing React derived state and the shared discovery scorer. URL/deep-link navigation remains authoritative; history is a bounded presentation/ranking signal rather than a new state machine or database.

higher_level_tradeoffs.reason: Cross-session/account persistence has more reach but adds product and privacy surface that the current personal homepage does not need.
A dedicated state runtime is unnecessary for one bounded array plus derived filters and would compete with existing navigation lifecycle.

decision.fallback: If future multi-device history becomes a real product requirement, add a narrow sync adapter around canonical IDs only; do not migrate destination identity, content records or camera/runtime state into that persistence layer.
